description: issue #678 (SP6): with the `sprites` profile active, a program that actually USES the turtle-identity reporters `who`/`new_turtle`/`turtles` checks clean — the checker's unknown-command rule recognizes them as visible command names because `collectVisibleNames` now registers the Sprites profile's primitives under an active `sprites` profile (since issue #966 by sweeping the profile-keyed registry rather than calling a Sprites-only accessor) (the SP6 gap SP5 documented: its clean fixture deliberately avoided the reporters because they were still unregistered). This fixture is the proof the gap is closed. `:leader`/`:friend` are assigned so they are not `ol-undefined-var`.
